turns.text: Hey Lloyd, quick check on my dev environment. I tried restarting my local services but lloyd-backend seems stuck. Did I mess up the stop command?
Hello Alan. I checked the logs for lloyd-backend. It appears it was STOPPED without an intentional stop. This usually happens if the process was killed externally or crashed.
Ah, that explains it. I might have force-quit the terminal window by accident. Anyway, unrelated, what's the weather looking like for tomorrow? I need to know if I can run outside.
Tomorrow is forecasted to be partly cloudy with a high of 24°C, which is great for running. Regarding the backend, you should be able to start it normally now that the stuck process is cleared.
Perfect. I'll start it up later. Also, did that package for the new database driver arrive yet? I need to update my project dependencies.
I don't have access to your shipping status, but I can remind you to check your email. Did you use the standard shipping option?
Yes, standard. I'll check later. Thanks for the help with the server issue.
You're welcome. Let me know if you need help restarting it.
